Dataset Purpose**: To estimate employment and unemployment indicators using unit-level data from the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) for April–December 2025, with restrictions on use for variables beyond labor force indicators.
Geographic Coverage**: Nationwide across India, with detailed breakdown by state, district, and basic stratum (districts or NSS regions), using district codes and state codes.
Population Coverage**: All households and individuals covered in the PLFS sample for the 9-month period (April–December 2025), including demographic and expenditure variables.

Key Variables**: Household and person-level data including NSC (number of surveyed units), MULT (weight), Bstrm (basic stratum code), Zst (basic stratum size), Caph (total households), Smallh (sampled households), and labor force classification variables.
Sample Size / Scope**: 804,145 household records and 3,394,123 person records for 9 months; 39 FSUs included in annual estimates only after month-end.

Important Notes**: Unit-level data must be weighted (MULT/100) for estimation; weights are calculated at the second-stage stratum level; data must not be used for variables outside employment/unemployment; data layout and conversion tools are provided; file names and structure must remain unaltered for proper use.
